text: nail search (nail/src/search.rs) runs: index queries, index targets (both untimed by -s), seeding under SerialTimed::Seeding, build_pipeline (untimed; profile construction is serial for hmm queries, the par path commented out), then the rayon par_chunks(100) pair loop under SerialTimed::Alignment, output included. Seeding misc is nail's mmseqs db writing plus prog mode's per-round slicing, counting and merging. --stats-results-path in args.rs is written by nothing.
